description: p1: a lmstudio 400 (error.code guardrail_violation) falls back to a vllm 503 (error.type server_error, error.code null) that also fails -- the top-level fields come from the last (fallback) attempt, server_error/503, not the primary's guardrail_violation/400. p2: a lmstudio 400 (context_length_exceeded) falls back to a vllm 200 that recovers -- the top-level fields are absent, while fallback_attempts[0] keeps its own error_code/http_status.
